# Getting Started with Our API

Welcome to our comprehensive API documentation. This guide will help you get up and running quickly.

## Quick Setup

1. Sign up for an account
2. Get your API key from the dashboard
3. Make your first request

> **Note:** Keep your API key secure and never share it publicly.

## Authentication

Our API uses API key authentication. Include your key in the header:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" https://api.example.com/v1/users
```

## Rate Limits

> **Important:** Our API has rate limits to ensure fair usage.

- **Free tier:** 100 requests per hour
- **Pro tier:** 1,000 requests per hour
- **Enterprise:** Custom limits

Need help?

Contact our support team at support@example.com or check our FAQ.
